findings_addressed: Distinct schemas for pure mapping and owner application receipts.
Mapper replays pinned original/view/manifest before relying on KEEP offsets.
Single KEEP containment plus exact post-edit reprojection rejects hidden-comment scope changes and replacement text stripped by codec.
UTF-8 and CRLF boundaries checked for transformed Python; explicit protected-line policy refuses LF edits.
Requested/effective profile, fallback reason and codec binding must remain stable.
Owner requires fresh clean linked native allocation, explicit lease/fence, independently supplied PatchScope and exact generation/source/view/manifest pins.
Whole admitted candidate byte bound checked before application.
Postapplication staged path and index bytes checked; admitted source postimage rechecked around refresh and final owner check.
Read-only worker source socket has no mutation dispatch.
limitations: Owner application supports fresh clean candidates, not incremental dirty overlays.
Pure identity mapping permits arbitrary bytes without Python syntax assurance; owner adapter accepts supported UTF-8 text patches only.
Unsupported patch path quoting, binary patches and create/delete/move operations are outside owner adapter scope.
Checks are sequential; external writers are not locked out and failed post-write checks may leave an isolated candidate requiring cleanup.
No broker/model tool or live benchmark arm is exposed by this host API.
Final broad regression suite was still running when this review was requested; no final suite count claimed here.
